purpose: Non-admission original-source discovery of alternative observed and reconstructed wildfire event perimeters, daily spread, multiagency event lists and independent validation candidates; no original dataset bytes, commercial rights, CAT model approval or portfolio loss admission.

entries.name: NASA-led Fire Events Data Suite (FEDS) CONUS Archive 2012-2025, Zenodo October 2026
entries.spatial_scope: Contiguous United States; published CONUS data archive; original source metadata must be checked for exact coverage
entries.temporal_scope: 2012-2025 archival event coverage; Zenodo release 2026-10-02, version 1; 12-hour reconstructed fire growth intervals
entries.resolution_or_granularity: VIIRS 375 m active fire derived event polygons and firelines at 12-hour intervals. Fully postprocessed large-fire fgb products cover fires above 4 km2; raw daily/parquet backing outputs are not equivalent to curated fire perimeters.
entries.note: Critical access blocker: the original Zenodo 2026-10-02 v1 record advertises Files: Restricted, zero publicly downloadable bytes in the listing. Do not confuse a visible metadata page or a secondary CC BY 4.0 tag with accessible asset bytes or granted rights. Algorithm v1.4.1, Suomi-NPP VIIRS VNP14IMGML collection 2 v4, 12-hour alpha-shape reconstructions; FEDS postprocessed FGB large-fire assets (>4 km2) differ materially from raw allfires/allpixels outputs (merge history not corrected). This product is not an all-fire census or independently validated insured-loss outcome. Investigate alternative authorized access, archive filename, source hash, VIIRS detection biases and multi-fire merge semantics before use.

entries.name: WUMI2026a Western US MTBS-Interagency compiled wildfire event and perimeter dataset (Dryad 2026 update)
entries.spatial_scope: Eleven contiguous western US states only, not a nationwide catalogue
entries.temporal_scope: WUMI archive labelled Jan 1984 to 2026-08-06 as of 2026 Dryad version update; verify exact archive year coverage per supplied version; previous WUMI2024a 1984-2024 is a separate vintage
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Original Dryad v2026a archive /api/v2/versions/458442/files: WUMI2026a_final_wildfire_lists.zip 4,683,571 bytes (small event-list candidate); fire_lists.zip 26,481,076 bytes, fire_maps.zip 822,779,079 bytes, original_data.zip 100,715,033,562 bytes. Identity and scientific comparability still unreviewed.
entries.note: Original Dryad API version 458442 (dataset version updated 2026-08-24) lists WUMI2026a_final_wildfire_lists.zip, 4,683,571 bytes, sha-256=8d8a59588935b832bf8e382a0c94b8a6705e6a8fa2bed161bacf1d9fe78726d0, metadata https://datadryad.org/api/v2/versions/458442/files . This is a publisher file metadata SHA, NOT a verified locally downloaded byte receipt. Dryad data page includes 2024a and 2026a versions while some abstract prose remains 2024a. Freeze exact Dryad version and individual file SHA256 and explicitly separate parent vs sub-fire identities, inferred vs observed perimeter origins. The 2025 peer-reviewed WUMI2024a research has 22,234 western wildfires >=1 km2 when complexes are disaggregated, but this figure is not automatically a WUMI2026a result. WUMI integrates MTBS and FPA, thus its event counts are not an independent frequency validation. Rights/science/admission not reviewed; start with the 4.68 MB original 2026 event list after source-specific permission review, not the 100.7 GB upstream ZIP.

entries.name: Earth Lab FIREDpy global country-level MODIS burned-area event polygons and daily perimeter products
entries.provider: CU Boulder Earth Lab / Balch Fire Lab
entries.spatial_scope: Multiple global country and regional datasets; coverage differs by country/version and MODIS processing mode
entries.temporal_scope: FIREDpy available country products span approximately 2000/2001-2021 to 2024/2025 depending on country and version; never assume global uniform year coverage
entries.resolution_or_granularity: MODIS MCD64A1 burn-area pixels grouped by space-time window into final event and optional daily perimeter GeoPackage/shapefile files; exact space-time thresholds and CRS vary by version.
entries.note: FIREDpy 1.0, 2.0 (2024f) and 2.1 (2025var) differ in algorithm thresholds and outputs. Original GitHub README states newer unpublished versions/data require PI Jennifer Balch permission before publications/presentations/public dissemination; do NOT treat software open-source license as permission to redistribute newly generated country data. README warns some Fall 2021 datasets can have a half-pixel shift or missing CRS. Keep publisher exact file, vintage, coverage, original DOI/asset bytes, CRS and suspected geometric shift in review. MODIS burned pixels may combine prescribed fires, crop burning, fires and multiple fire detections; not automatically independent of other MCD64A1-derived catalogues.

entries.name: NASA ORNL DAAC integrated Wildfire Event Dataset (iWED) v1, 1992-2021
entries.provider: NASA ORNL Distributed Active Archive Center / Kasischke and colleagues
entries.spatial_scope: United States, contiguous states plus Alaska as represented by NASA's original source description; state-level event geography in this version
entries.temporal_scope: 1992-2021, published 2026-07-31 per NASA Earthdata catalogue; version 1
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Three CSV files (wildfire events, event notes and source list); only state geographic labels, no individual latitude/longitude in v1; selection wildfire events >=100 ha.
entries.note: NASA Earthdata catalogue says freely shared without restriction, but the zipped data distribution resolves via a protected Earthdata route that may require sign-in; no authenticated asset fetch has been completed. v1 does not include individual event geocoordinates and therefore cannot be directly intersected with buildings; retain state-level use only. This integrated dataset draws from agency reports and MTBS; it is not independent validation of FPA-FOD or MTBS counts. Freeze DOI/version, exact three CSV hashes and data-source attribution plus missing/censoring patterns before any model use.

entries.name: European Commission JRC GWIS GlobFire v2 daily fire-event perimeters (Earth Engine)
entries.provider: European Commission Joint Research Centre / Global Wildfire Information System
entries.spatial_scope: Global satellite-derived coverage subject to MODIS land, cloud, resolution and detection limitations
entries.temporal_scope: 2001-01-01 to 2021-01-01 service window (nominal fire events during 2001-2020); fixed Earth Engine collection identity v2
entries.resolution_or_granularity: MODIS MCD64A1 burned-area-derived daily fire event geometries and source-local event IDs, accessible via Google Earth Engine dataset JRC/GWIS/GlobFire/v2/DailyPerimeters.
entries.note: The official dataset page lists CC BY 4.0 and daily perimeters through Jan 2021 but that does not itself grant any project-specific admission. Derived from MODIS MCD64A1, like FIREDpy, so the two sources share observational ancestry and cannot be counted as independent evidence. Verify the Earth Engine account/access path, event-ID uniqueness across years and continents, difference between final and daily perimeters, fire-event merge semantics and historical latency. Cloud/radiometric detection limits can miss small, short or low-severity events. Not equivalent to reported FPA ignitions, CAL FIRE destroyed buildings or insured claims.
